description: Hyperlocal Flash Flood & Landslide Susceptibility Inference Model

feature_descriptions.rainfall: Current hourly rainfall rate in mm/h
feature_descriptions.elevation: Topographical elevation above sea level in meters
feature_descriptions.drainage_condition: Stormwater drainage hydraulic efficiency score (0=completely choked, 100=optimal flow)
feature_descriptions.historical_events: Number of documented flood/landslide events in last 10 years
feature_descriptions.sensor_water_level: River or stormwater culvert gauge water level in meters
feature_descriptions.impervious_surface_pct: Percentage of paved/concrete urban surface (runoff coefficient factor)
